commands.cmd: p=$(command -v repomix) && echo "resolves: $p -> $(readlink -f "$p")" && repomix --version && python3 -c "import json,glob,sys;c=sys.argv[1];print('stack',[x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']==c],'winner pins',sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')==c}))" repomix

d=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1; repomix --include "fixtures/before.py,fixtures/after.py,fixtures/example.sh" --style xml --parsable-style --compress --token-count-encoding o200k_base --output "$d/pack.xml" --quiet; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then python3 -c "import sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as E;r=E.parse(sys.argv[1]).getroot();f={e.get('path'):(e.text or '') for e in r.iter('file')};src={p:open(p).read() for p in f};py=[p for p in f if p.endswith('.py')];sig=all(f[p].strip()=='def greeting(name)' for p in py);body=all('return' in src[p] and 'return' not in f[p] for p in py);sh=f.get('fixtures/example.sh','').strip()==src.get('fixtures/example.sh','').strip();print('XML parsed; packed files',len(f),sorted(f),'| each .py packed as signature def greeting(name):',sig,'| return bodies in sources, absent from pack:',body,'| example.sh kept verbatim:',sh,'| fixtures/records.json packed:','fixtures/records.json' in f);raise SystemExit(0 if sorted(f)==['fixtures/after.py','fixtures/before.py','fixtures/example.sh'] and py and sig and body and sh else 1)" "$d/pack.xml"; rc=$?; else echo "repomix exit $rc"; fi; rm -rf "$d"; exit $rc
